rows.en: But the Blue Stone of Baraj is guarded by a stone statue, and we weren't strong enough to take it.
Huh? Hold on a sec.
How are we supposed to get something you lot couldn't? This isn't a trap, is it?
...For some reason, that statue looks exactly like an Ultra Warrior.
It looks exactly like an Ultra Warrior.
What...!?
Long ago in Baraj, it seems an Ultra Warrior was called "the God of Noah"...
...and worshipped as their guardian deity.
So we figured that if an Ultra Warrior went there, they might be able to get it...
Though that's nothing more than a guess...
Tch, how stupid. Don't come leaning on us over some half-baked hunch!
It's worth a shot.
We'll take it on.
I think it's worth a try.
We'll take it on.
It's worth a try!
We'll take it on!
It's worth trying.
We'll take on that request.
It's worth a try, I guess.
Let's give it a shot.
Now this sounds like fun!!
Count me in!
It's worth a shot.
Fine, let's damn well do it!
Tch... Do whatever you want.
All right, we're counting on you. Now, as for who'll guide you to Baraj...
Now, as for who'll guide you to Baraj...
Wing Zero is going to go with you.
...I'm counting on you.
That okay with you?
Mission accepted.
Hey, are we really gonna be fine with a guy like this?
Baraj lies to the west.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
This is the target point.
Also, this mission requires an Ultra Warrior in the party.
Tch, it's a pain, but there's no helping it.
I'll leave the timing of the mission up to you.
Wing Zero joined the party!
Got it. Let's head for Baraj.
Got it. Let's head for Baraj.
Understood. Let's head for Baraj.
Got it. Let's head for Baraj.
Understood. Let's head for Baraj.
Right, I'm headin' to this Baraj place!
Before you lies a giant antlion pit: "Antlar's Nest."
A powerful magnetic force is pulling you in!
It's too dangerous to get any closer!
Looks like you got the Blue Stone of Baraj.
Now, quick, throw it into the nest!
Throw the Blue Stone of Baraj in?
{8074} threw the Blue Stone of Baraj into Antlar's Nest!
Kiiaaaah~~~!!
{8074} stared at Antlar's Nest, still clutching the Blue Stone of Baraj.
Antlar's Nest vanished!
Did we get it!?
Shall we go check on the "Ride Gate"?
What's wrong? Hurry up and throw it in.
We've already heard about you from Master Deathscythe Hell.
We've been instructed that no one is to go past this point until the operation begins.
The infiltration route into the Wasteland Zone is up ahead.
There's a stone statue that looks a lot like an Ultra Warrior.
It holds the "Blue Stone of Baraj" in its hand.
Huh? Is that the thing they call the Blue Stone of Baraj?
Ankh tried to snatch the Blue Stone of Baraj.
But a mysterious power held it fast to the statue, and it wouldn't come loose.
Damn it!! No good, it won't budge an inch.
Just as I thought. We need an Ultra Warrior's power.
Just as I thought. We need an Ultra Warrior's power.
Just as I thought. We need an Ultra Warrior's power.
So we really do need an Ultra Warrior's power...
Guess we really do need an Ultra Warrior's power, huh?
Just as I thought. We need an Ultra Warrior's power...
Huh? Is that the thing they call the Blue Stone of Baraj?
Then I'll get it!
Mebius reached out to the statue and grabbed the Blue Stone of Baraj!
All right! Leave it to me!!
Zero reached out to the statue and grabbed the Blue Stone of Baraj!
Obtained the Blue Stone of Baraj.

notes.note: Continues Arios's explanation from story_025 (#0.24). 'With our strength we couldn't take it' rendered 'we weren't strong enough to take it'.
#0.29 is a shorter variant of #0.28; #0.30 (no speaker) is a party reaction, kept neutral.
'Noa no kami' rendered 'the God of Noah' (Ultraman ep. 7 Baraj legend; not in glossary). Singular 'an Ultra Warrior' chosen as the statue is one figure.
Subject restored as 'we figured' (Heavyarms and Arios's reasoning); source trails off, kept.
No speaker recovered; voiced as Ankh (rude 'Tch', continues his trap objection in #0.27).

#0.39-0.52 are 7 leader-variant pairs in the usual order (Zero, Gundam, Mebius, W, OOO, Momotaros, other Gundam); voiced by register. 'Hikiukeyou' rendered 'We'll take it on' (leader speaking for the team). #0.53 is Ankh's grudging reply.

No speaker. Read as Heavyarms (opens with '...', as in #0.28) entrusting the job to Wing Zero; #0.58 (Arios?) asks if that's okay, and Wing Zero answers 'Mission accepted.' (#0.59). If #0.57 is Wing Zero addressing the party, 'I'm counting on you' still fits. #0.60 is Ankh.
#0.68-0.73 are leader variants (only #0.68 labelled Zero); #0.70/#0.72 polite (Mebius/OOO), #0.73 rough (Momotaros).
Quoted 'Antlar no Su' capitalised 'Antlar's Nest' as a named spot in system text; Arios's dialogue keeps lowercase 'nest' (as in story_025).
Antlar's roar romanised; no earlier English precedent for this exact roar (story_027 0225.7 repeats it).
Precedent 0206 #0.15 'Did we get them?'; here singular 'it' (Antlar).
Legacy, badly mis-decoded; speaker label 'Waste Yummy' is wrong. Same shape as 0212 #0.3 (Maganac), so translated identically. Guess.
'Kouya Chitai' rendered 'Wasteland Zone' (not in glossary; parallels 'Quicksand Zone').
#0.8-0.13 are leader variants (story_027 0223 labels the parallel set Nu, Zeta, W, OOO, Den-O); #0.8 label 'Wing Zero' likely shifted. Subject restored as 'we'.
Labelled Wing Zero, but the polite 'boku' line and the next row (Mebius grabs the stone) show it is Mebius. #0.20 is Zero's variant.

report: All rows translated. Uncertain: 0218.1 (legacy garble, matched to 0212.3), 0215 #0.57-0.58 speakers inferred, 0222.18 label wrong (Mebius). New terms: 'God of Noah', 'Wasteland Zone', 'Antlar's Nest', Antlar roar.
